verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor, not a software product that holds user data, so getting AI-generated insights from data inside the product is the wrong axis for it. The evidence covers NPU TOPS, Copilot+ PC positioning and developer tooling (AI Hub, the AI Engine Direct SDK) for running models on the chip. None of it shows the chip itself delivering data insights or suggestions to users.
